summary: Senior Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience designing, developing, modernizing, and optimizing interactive web applications, enterprise platforms, cloud-native solutions, APIs, and distributed systems. Extensive experience building modern web experiences using TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, HTML, CSS, Python, and Node.js, with a strong focus on performance, usability, reusable architecture, and maintainable code. Partnered with engineers, product teams, data scientists, industry specialists, and customer-facing stakeholders to define requirements, evaluate technical feasibility, refine application experiences, and deliver working solutions.
Built modern web applications using React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Docker, integrating interactive frontend experiences with APIs, data platforms, distributed services, and generative AI capabilities.

Built and maintained APIs, backend services, data synchronization workflows, and third-party integrations supporting digital business operations.
Reduced GraphQL API latency by 50% by implementing a DynamoDB-backed caching strategy that minimized Salesforce requests and improved application responsiveness.
Developed a shell-based local development environment that automatically configured Docker containers, development tools, and test repositories, improving developer onboarding and setup consistency.
Troubleshoot application integrations, data synchronization, performance, and environment configuration issues across internal and external systems.
Managed digital content workflows for conferences and webinars, ensuring accurate metadata, content sequencing, and sponsor visibility across online platforms.
Collaborated with business, marketing, technical, and external platform stakeholders to gather requirements, coordinate integrations, and resolve system issues.

Led the design, development, integration, and maintenance of enterprise applications supporting ecommerce, customer service, accounting, warehouse operations, marketing, and internal business processes.
Optimized the architecture and performance of a B2B ecommerce platform responsible for approximately 79% of company revenue.
Designed and implemented integrations with PureClarity, Campaigner, Yotpo, Intercom, and other third-party platforms using APIs, webhooks, microservices, and Redis-backed message queues to support reliable data exchange and digital engagement.

Improved employee productivity by approximately 90% by automating essential business workflows and replacing manual processes with custom applications.
Developed applications managing more than 18,000 products and images while maintaining accurate product information and digital assets.

Trained more than 30 employees on new applications, tools, and workflows to improve adoption, productivity, and service quality.

Administered MySQL databases and completed domain mappings, website migrations, and database transfers while maintaining availability, data integrity, and secure access.
Monitored web traffic and server activity to identify unusual access patterns, application usage trends, availability concerns, and potential security risks.
Installed and maintained TLS certificates and website security controls to encrypt data in transit and restrict unauthorized access.
Configured, maintained, and troubleshot Unix-based web servers supporting internet-facing applications.
Resolved production availability, configuration, access, permissions, connectivity, and application issues.
